title: Beynimdeki Postacı Leo
author: Ömer Faruk Tavşanlı
description: Leo is a tiny postman who lives inside the brain, sorting, delivering, and organizing every new piece of information. When Ali travels to Amsterdam for the first time, every new word, place, discovery and experience fills him with excitement, and gives Leo plenty of work to do. Hidden inside Ali's brain, Leo’s job is to sort every new piece of information into the right place. As Ali explores Amsterdam, visits museums, and discovers unfamiliar names and ideas, Leo carefully organizes each new memory, helping readers see what happens inside the brain every time we learn something new.
english_title: Leo The Postman in My Brain
